error.BEUSER_INPUT_INVALID: The BeUser request does not match its admitted journey.
remedy.BEUSER_INPUT_INVALID: Inspect the admitted candidate and journey pins before starting a new request.
error.BEUSER_TARGET_NOT_SANDBOX: BeUser refused a target whose isolated realm and Attempt could not be verified.
remedy.BEUSER_TARGET_NOT_SANDBOX: Keep the result invalid. Reconcile the same Attempt and retained realm custody; do not change to a host target.
error.BEUSER_LIMITS_UNAVAILABLE: A complete finite BeUser limits profile is unavailable.
remedy.BEUSER_LIMITS_UNAVAILABLE: Provide a complete registry profile through the installation owner; missing values do not admit a walk.
error.BEUSER_MODEL_OUTPUT_INVALID: The BeUser model returned an invalid JSON action or assessment.
remedy.BEUSER_MODEL_OUTPUT_INVALID: Inspect the model connection and output contract. Correction attempts use the existing call, patience and time limits.
error.BEUSER_MODEL_UNAVAILABLE: No active, authorized model satisfies this BeUser role. Inspect deckent models roles and deckent models list before reopening deckent beuser setup.
remedy.BEUSER_MODEL_UNAVAILABLE: Inspect deckent models roles and deckent models list; correct the person’s role/active-model choice, then reopen deckent beuser setup.
error.BEUSER_SURFACE_UNAVAILABLE: The isolated BeUser terminal driver is unavailable.
remedy.BEUSER_SURFACE_UNAVAILABLE: Inspect the retained realm and packaged driver evidence; do not open a host socket or bypass isolation.
error.BEUSER_SURFACE_INVALID: The BeUser terminal observation could not be verified.
remedy.BEUSER_SURFACE_INVALID: Keep the result unknown or invalid and inspect the retained observation before any new action.
error.BEUSER_ACTION_INVALID: The BeUser terminal refused the walker's action before sending it: an unknown key name, or empty or control text.
remedy.BEUSER_ACTION_INVALID: The walker was asked to correct its action within its patience; inspect the retained refused action rows if it kept choosing one.
error.BEUSER_SURFACE_LIMIT: The BeUser terminal reached its pinned limit.
remedy.BEUSER_SURFACE_LIMIT: Inspect the recorded limit and cleanup result. A limit does not authorize an automatic retry.
error.BEUSER_SURFACE_BUSY: A BeUser terminal action is still in progress.
remedy.BEUSER_SURFACE_BUSY: Wait for the owned action to settle within its deadline; do not queue a duplicate action.
error.BEUSER_CAPTURE_BLOCKED: BeUser capture is closed for a secret step.
remedy.BEUSER_CAPTURE_BLOCKED: Resume capture only after the trusted harness proves the secret process and descriptors ended.
error.BEUSER_SURFACE_EOF: The isolated BeUser terminal process ended.
remedy.BEUSER_SURFACE_EOF: Inspect the process result and cleanup evidence. End of output is not journey acceptance.
error.BACKUP_REALM_SEALED: A sealed BeUser installation cannot be backed up, restored or exported.
remedy.BACKUP_REALM_SEALED: Keep backup-dependent uninstall and restore branches unknown. Do not remove the seal or skip the required backup.
beuser.report.title: BeUser journey report
beuser.report.disclaimer: Simulated, uncalibrated. This report does not authorize adoption or release.
beuser.report.calibration: Calibration {revision}: traps {trapHits}/{trapTotal}, false RED {falseRed}/{goodTotal}; minimum hit rate {minimumHitRate}, maximum false RED rate {maximumFalseRedRate}; k {k}, retries {retries}.
beuser.report.segment: Segment {segment}: outcome {outcome}; authorization {authorization}; safety {safety}; experience {experience}; validity {validity}; independence {independence}.
beuser.report.stuck: Diagnostic finding — {outcome}: persona {persona} is stuck in branch {branch} (repeated screen/action). Screen {screenRef}: {screen}. Evidence: {refs}.
beuser.report.observing: Diagnostic finding — {outcome}: persona {persona} is stuck in branch {branch} (only looked or waited while the screen stayed the same). Screen {screenRef}: {screen}. Evidence: {refs}.
beuser.report.patience: Diagnostic finding — {outcome}: persona {persona} ran out of waiting patience in branch {branch} (the waits it would accept are used up). Screen {screenRef}: {screen}. Evidence: {refs}.
beuser.help.summary: Walk an isolated product journey or read its retained report.
beuser.help.family:
deckent beuser setup --profile <path> [--scope <id>] [--apply] [--json]
deckent beuser walk --journey <id> --candidate <path> [--scope <id>] [--json]
deckent beuser report [--run <id>] [--scope <id>] [--json]
beuser.help.walk.summary: Walk a pinned journey in an isolated realm.
beuser.help.report.summary: Read a retained BeUser journey report.
beuser.help.walk:
deckent beuser walk --journey <id> --candidate <path> [--scope <id>] [--json] [--lang en|tr]
The installed journey, candidate, policy and finite limits must be verified before work begins. Cancellation retains uncertain cleanup.
beuser.help.report:
deckent beuser report [--run <id>] [--scope <id>] [--json] [--lang en|tr]
Reads the retained report with Run inspection authority. Simulated, uncalibrated; this report does not authorize adoption.
Omitting --run reads this person's latest retained report.
beuser.installation.systemRows: System policy data {digest}: {status}; reason {reason}; conflicts {conflicts}; withheld {withheld}.
error.BEUSER_PROFILE_REQUIRED: No BeUser execution profile is installed for this journey. Open deckent beuser setup --help on the person's terminal.
remedy.BEUSER_PROFILE_REQUIRED: Open deckent beuser setup --help on the person’s terminal to install a profile.
error.BEUSER_REPORT_NOT_FOUND: No BeUser report is available yet. Open deckent beuser walk --help for the next step.
remedy.BEUSER_REPORT_NOT_FOUND: Use deckent beuser walk --help to run an installed journey first.
error.BEUSER_SETUP_CONFLICT: Existing execution settings differ from the selected profile.
remedy.BEUSER_SETUP_CONFLICT: Preserve the existing registry and pool; reconcile the difference through the person’s config card.
beuser.help.setup:
deckent beuser setup --profile <path> [--scope <id>] [--apply] [--json] [--lang tr|en]
Requires the person’s terminal. A finite admission profile document supplies registry BeUser profiles with journey/persona/rubric, exact candidate manifest, limits revision and existing active role choices; poolId, executionSlots, inFlightSlots and ordering describe the pool. Preview first; --apply uses the person card and config policy/digest/audit path. Creates no model, key or permission.
beuser.setup.change: Scope: {scope}; approved content: {digest}. Install this execution registry and pool.
error.BEUSER_CANDIDATE_MISMATCH: The candidate manifest or package identity does not match the admitted reference.
remedy.BEUSER_CANDIDATE_MISMATCH: Regenerate the BeUser profile from the exact staged candidate, then preview setup again.
error.BEUSER_START_STATE_UNMET: The BeUser start state could not be arranged or read back, so the persona did not start.
remedy.BEUSER_START_STATE_UNMET: Keep the branch unknown and inspect the retained arrange record. A start state that needs a person's witness is never forced or retried.
beuser.report.filesystem.daemon-attested: daemon-attested (daemon statement; no independent filesystem proof)
error.BEUSER_START_STATE_UNREACHABLE: A BeUser start state of this branch cannot be arranged in the realm, so the persona did not start.
remedy.BEUSER_START_STATE_UNREACHABLE: Keep the branch unknown; the report names each such state and why. Nothing bypasses a person's witness or the realm's isolation to reach it.
beuser.report.unarranged.realm-external: outside the isolated realm (service manager, Docker, network, model or another OS)
beuser.report.unarranged.driver-limit: the terminal driver cannot present it faithfully
beuser.report.unarranged.persona: the persona establishes it during the walk
